tl: Nasa ibabaw ba ng lupa ang lugar ng Chocolate Hills noon?
en: Was the Chocolate Hills area always dry land?
ans: Noong unang panahon, ito ay coral reef sa ilalim ng dagat na umangat at naging tuyong lupa!
en_ans: Long ago, it was a coral reef under the sea that lifted up to become dry land!

tl: Matibay ba ang tigas na konkreto kapag idinidiin at hinihila?
en: Is hardened concrete strong when you push and pull it?
ans: Napakalakas ito kapag idinidiin (compression) pero mahina kapag hinihila (tension), kaya naluluray ito kapag binanat!
en_ans: It’s very strong when pushed (compression) but weak when pulled apart (tension), so it can crack when stretched!

tl: Bakit mapanganib ang nahuhulog na niyog?
en: Why is a falling coconut so dangerous?
ans: Habang nahuhulog ang niyog, lalo itong bumibilis — kaya lumalaki ang momentum nito at mas masakit ang tama!
en_ans: As a coconut falls, it speeds up — so its momentum grows bigger and it hits much harder!

tl: Gusto mong pigilan ang dengue fever tuwing tag-ulan?
en: Want to stop dengue fever this wet season?
ans: Alisin ang nakatigil na tubig sa mga lumang gulong! Pigilan nito ang paglaylay ng lamok at pagkalat ng dengue fever.
en_ans: Empty stagnant water from old tires! This prevents mosquitoes from breeding and stops the spread of dengue fever.
